body: Read again, but slowly. The sentence you erased is innocuous. It's describing what it returns in case of failure. Then, the note below explains **when** the TinyEXR module is disabled. If anything, the _"which means [method save_exr] will return [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when it is called from an exported project."_ is the repetitive part, here.
